abstract: OBJECTIVES: To explore and correlate the ultrasonic, clinical, and pathological characteristics of malignant ovarian tumors in children for early diagnosis and pathological typing. METHODS: A retrospective analysis was performed on the ultrasonic examination results, clinical data, and laboratory indicators of 49 cases of pathologically confirmed malignant ovarian tumors in children from January 2020 to December 2024. RESULTS: (1) Pathological types: Germ cell tumors accounted for 75.5% (immature teratoma 59.5%, endodermal sinus tumor and mixed germ cell tumor each 16.2%), sex cord-stromal tumors accounted for 16.3%, and lymphoma accounted for 8.2%. (2) Ultrasonic characteristics: Tumors were predominantly large (>10 cm, 73.5%), solid (51.0%), with irregular contours (81.6%), calcification (57.1%), and high-risk ovarian-adnexal reporting and data system (O-RADS) 4-5 (98.0%). (3) Significant differences were observed among different pathological types: Germ cell tumors were mostly unilateral, large-sized, and accompanied by calcification, with significantly elevated alpha-fetoprotein (AFP); sex cord-stromal tumors were solid without calcification, and 37.5% were associated with precocious puberty; lymphoma was predominantly bilateral, small-sized, and solid, with elevated lactate dehydrogenase (LDH). (4) Clinical features: Pubertal patients accounted for 32.7%; the primary presenting symptoms were abdominal pain/distension (55.1%). CONCLUSIONS: Childhood malignant ovarian tumors are predominantly germ cell tumors, manifesting as large, solid-predominant, calcified lesions with high-risk ultrasound features. Ultrasonic, clinical, and laboratory features vary significantly by pathological type. Integrating these characteristics (including O-RADS and tumor markers) enables preoperative pathological diagnosis, supporting early multi-dimensional and personalized management.
abstract_ja:
目的: 小児悪性卵巣腫瘍の超音波、臨床、病理学的特徴を検討し、早期診断と病理学的分類に役立てること。
方法: 2020年1月から2024年12月までに病理学的に確認された小児悪性卵巣腫瘍49例について、超音波検査結果、臨床データ、検査指標を後方視的に解析した。
結果: (1)病理型:胚細胞腫瘍が75.5%を占め(未熟奇形腫59.5%、卵黄嚢腫瘍と混合型胚細胞腫瘍がそれぞれ16.2%)、性索間質性腫瘍が16.3%、リンパ腫が8.2%であった。(2)超音波の特徴:腫瘍は大きいもの(>10 cm、73.5%)が多く、充実性(51.0%)、不整な輪郭(81.6%)、石灰化(57.1%)を示し、O-RADS 4-5の高リスク所見が98.0%であった。(3)病理型による有意差:胚細胞腫瘍は大部分が単側性で、大きく、石灰化を伴い、α-フェトプロテイン(AFP)が有意に上昇していた。性索間質性腫瘍は石灰化のない充実性で、37.5%に思春期早発症が関連していた。リンパ腫は両側性、小型、充実性が主で、乳酸脱水素酵素(LDH)が上昇していた。(4)臨床的特徴:思春期の患者が32.7%を占め、主な初発症状は腹痛・腹部膨満(55.1%)であった。
結論: 小児の悪性卵巣腫瘍は主に胚細胞腫瘍であり、大きく充実性優位で石灰化を伴う病変として現れ、高リスクの超音波所見を示す。超音波、臨床、検査所見は病理型によって著しく異なる。O-RADSや腫瘍マーカーを含むこれらの特徴を統合することで、術前の病理診断が可能となり、早期の多面的かつ個別化された治療を支援できる。
